logros.nombre: This is Where Simplified Chaos Begins
logros.descripcion: Unlock Sound Test, allowing you to play any stage at any time (in-game slow mo when paused is not allowed unless stated)

logros.nombre: Wait, It's All Act 1? Always Has Been
logros.descripcion: Return to the earliest part of Angel Island Zone's act 1 during act 2, no Debug Mode
Reach the one who chuckles at the end of Angel Island Zone act 2, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: To Boldly Tube Where Every Hedgehog Has Gone Before
logros.descripcion: In Angel Island Zone act 2, land on top of a hidden platform just before the airship bombing sequence as Sonic or Tails and make your way back to before the final tube, no Debug Mode
In Angel Island Zone act 2, backtrack and enter the final tube in Sonic/Tails' route as Knuckles, no Debug Mode
In Hydrocity Zone act 1, see what happens if you return to the bottom of the starting waterfall after using the first high-speed water route, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: Come Up Here and Fight Me!
logros.descripcion: Get softlocked above Hydrocity Zone's act 1 miniboss, no Debug Mode
In Hydrocity Zone act 1, fly beyond the walls and reach the duplicate level layout and continue until you can't go any farther as Tails, no Debug Mode
In Hydrocity Zone act 2, go above the ceiling and warp from the left side of the stage to the right as Knuckles, no Debug Mode
In Hydrocity Zone act 2, use a ramp to warp from the left side of the stage to the right as Sonic or Tails, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: Laughing on the Sidelines About Pronunciations
logros.descripcion: In Hydrocity Zone act 2, reach Knuckles' side of the barrier as Sonic or Tails, no Debug Mode
In Hydrocity Zone act 2, reach the duplicate level layout and make your way to the boss as Tails, no Debug Mode
In Marble Garden Zone act 1, go beyond the boss into the duplicate level layout and defeat Dr. Robotnik/Eggman, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: What Do You Mean This Duo was Introduced in A.I.R.?
logros.descripcion: Reach and defeat Sonic and Tails' Marble Garden Zone act 2 boss as Knuckles, no Debug Mode. The trigger icon should appear during the fight and when near the last checkpoint
Reach and defeat Knuckles' Marble Garden Zone act 2 boss as Sonic alone or with Tails, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: The Teleporter is for Echidnas Only
logros.descripcion: Reach the teleporter in Carnival Night Zone act 2 as anyone besides Knuckles, no Debug Mode
Reach and defeat Sonic/Tails' Carnival Night Zone act 2 boss as Knuckles, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: Pay No Attention to the Eggman Behind the Curtain
logros.descripcion: In Carnival Night Zone act 2, go beyond the walls and reach the duplicate level layout and continue until you can't go any farther as Knuckles, no Debug Mode
Reach and defeat Knuckles' Icecap Zone act 1 boss as anyone besides Knuckles, no Debug Mode
Reach and defeat Sonic and Tails' Icecap Zone act 1 boss as Knuckles, no Debug Mode
In Icecap Zone act 1, go beyond the boss and defeat the act 2 boss, no Debug Mode
Get shoved into the ceiling by an ice crusher and live in Icecap Zone act 2, no Debug Mode
Reach and defeat Knuckles' Launch Base Zone act 1 boss as anyone besides Knuckles, no Debug Mode but in-game slow mo is allowed
In Launch Base Zone act 2, use elemental shields to cause the water to change color as Sonic or Tails, no Debug Mode
Reach and defeat Sonic and Tails' Launch Base Zone act 2 bosses as Knuckles, no Debug Mode
In Mushroom Hill Zone act 1, reach Knuckles' first giant ring as Sonic, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: Venting Frustrations If You Wanna Fly High
logros.descripcion: In Mushroom Hill Zone act 2, reach the platform with two ring monitors without touching the ground after the Knuckles cutscene as Tails, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: Not Meeting on a Mushroom Planet, but Close Enough
logros.descripcion: In Mushroom Hill Zone act 2, cause the boss to not fully be Egg Robo as Knuckles without pausing after respawning and before the boss spawns, no Debug Mode
As Tails in Flying Battery Zone act 1, fly above the three rows of rings in the sky with an electric shield without collecting any of them, no Debug Mode

In Flying Battery Zone act 1, clip through the wall next to the electric shield and invincibility monitors at the start and then clear the act without changing animations after clipping, no Debug Mode
In Sandpolis Zone act 1, clip into a ceiling to warp from the left side of the stage to the right as Tails, no Debug Mode
In Sandopolis Zone act 1, find a way to push a block up a sliding sand slope, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: Help, I Have Risen, and Can't Get Down
logros.descripcion: In Sandopollis Zone act 1, jump back onto a hanging rope handle before it leaves that will get you softlocked, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: Getting Buried in an Exotic Tomb
logros.descripcion: Go into the ceiling thanks to a sand pillar in Sandopolis Zone act 2 and live, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: Trapped in the Great Reef Offensive
logros.descripcion: In Lava Reef Zone act 1, cause the game to fail loading act 2 and then head for the surface as Tails, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: It's Balderdash to Avoid a Boulder Crash
logros.descripcion: In Lava Reef Zone act 2, softlock during the Knuckles boulder cutscene as Sonic or Tails, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: With Wrecks or Inflatables, I'LL CRUSH YOU!
logros.descripcion: In Sky Sanctuary Zone, clear the Sonic/Tails version of the zone at either the Egg Wrecker or Egg Bouncer arena as Tails. Do not use the teleporters if a boss dies, no Debug Mode
In Death Egg Zone act 2, survive falling into a pit... provided you don't move or do anything (stay there for 4 seconds), no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: What You Hold After Losing Everything
logros.descripcion: As Knuckles, get pushed off a wall you're holding on to and try to climb, no Debug Mode
Right before getting a Time Over, perform an air dash as Hyper Sonic, no Debug Mode

logros.nombre: This is Where the True Chaos Begins
logros.descripcion: Unlock Debug Mode, allowing you to play any stage as any character

logros.nombre: More Than Enough Bling for a Hedgehog
logros.descripcion: Cause your ring count to go above the maximum of 999, Debug Mode allowed
In Angel Island Zone act 1 as Sonic, stop the island from going on fire by... making checkpoints? Debug Mode allowed
Battle two copies of Dr. Robotnik/Eggman in Angel Island Zone act 2 and meet Knuckles, Debug Mode allowed until you reach the boss fight bridge and don't place anything
In Hydrocity Zone act 1 without touching any checkpoints, die during the results screen and then clear act 2, Debug Mode allowed

logros.nombre: They Really Are the Fastest Things Alive
logros.descripcion: Zip from the far left side of Carnival Night Zone act 2 to the right, Debug Mode allowed

logros.nombre: The True Power of the Master Emerald Guardian
logros.descripcion: Cause Knuckles to give your sprites a makeover in Hidden Palace Zone as Sonic or Tails, Debug Mode allowed
Clear Doomsday Zone act 2 as Knuckles. Unlock Debug Mode to access the stage as Knuckles, but don't activate it by holding A+Start on the level select screen
Clear Doomsday Zone act 1 as Tails and as Knuckles in one session. Unlock Debug Mode to access the stage as Tails and Knuckles, but don't activate it by holding A+Start on the level select screen

logros.nombre: There and Back Again, a Hedgehog's Tale
logros.descripcion: Return to Angel Island Zone from Hidden Palace Zone, Debug Mode allowed
Cause the game to let you use the glitched character, Blue Knuckles, and enter a stage, Debug Mode allowed

logros.nombre: Chuckling by Yourself; Learning Your Home is Truly Hell
logros.descripcion: In Angel Island Zone act 1, suffer a horrible fate trying to reach the miniboss as Blue Knuckles. Unlock and use Debug Mode to get Blue Knuckles, but don't activate it by holding A+Start on the level select screen

logros.nombre: Well, He Did Have Egg in his Name
logros.descripcion: Defeat Dr. Robotnik/Eggman in Hidden Palace Zone, Debug Mode allowed

logros.nombre: As If One Mecha Wasn't Bad Enough...
logros.descripcion: Battle three Mecha Sonics as Knuckles in Sky Sanctuary Zone, Debug Mode allowed for setup only (See comments)
Defeat the three Mecha Sonics without getting hit as Knuckles in Sky Sanctuary Zone, Debug Mode allowed for setup only (See comments)
Cause the game to revert back to Sonic & Knuckles standalone, Debug Mode allowed

After reverting the game back to just Sonic & Knuckles, reach and defeat the boss in Mushroom Hill Zone act 1 as Knuckles during his opening cutscene using Debug Mode. What, no goal post? Pressing Start might help... or not
As anyone besides Knuckles, cause the color palette to change for Mushroom Hill Zone act 1's background, Debug Mode and in-game slow mo allowed
As Tails, beat a boss in the vertical orb bonus stage, Debug Mode allowed

logros.nombre: No Way! No Way! No Way! No Way?
logros.descripcion: Access Blue Sphere from Sandopolis Zone act 1, Debug Mode allowed

logros.nombre: Am I Even Playing Sonic 3 Anymore?
logros.descripcion: Clear stage 058907237 of Blue Sphere with a perfect

There's a price to messing with Debug Mode. Cause the game to go extremely slow in a Blue Sphere stage. That trick to play Sonic & Knuckles might help... NOTE: It is recommended to use the Genesis Plus GX core, not Picodrive!

logros.nombre: Can't Bug Out if You De-bug the Debug
logros.descripcion: Cause the game to completely reset, disabling Sound Test and Debug Mode, Debug Mode allowed
